clients.title: Use with other clients
clients.intro: This server can answer the LibreSpeed and OpenSpeedTest protocols and serve an Apple networkQuality config, so you can test against it from a terminal or another UI. The operator chooses which are on.

about.unreachable: The commands below are built from this page's address, {origin}. BitGauge can't check which clients the operator enabled, or the server's name, until the server answers.

layers.offTitle: Not enabled on this server — the operator can enable it.

openspeedtest.name: OpenSpeedTest™ web UI
openspeedtest.desc: Open your own self-hosted OpenSpeedTest UI and point it at this server with the Host parameter.
openspeedtest.offWhat: The OpenSpeedTest protocol endpoints are switched off, so an OpenSpeedTest UI can't test against this server.
openspeedtest.note: The results link in the OpenSpeedTest UI contacts OpenSpeedTest, not this server.

librespeed.name: librespeed-cli
librespeed.desc: Save this server to a local list, then run the CLI against it.
librespeed.offWhat: The LibreSpeed protocol endpoints are switched off, so librespeed-cli can't test against this server.

networkquality.name: macOS networkQuality
networkquality.desc: Apple's built-in tool reports throughput and responsiveness (RPM). Point it at this server's config.
networkquality.offWhat: The networkQuality config isn't served, so networkQuality -C can't use this server.
networkquality.https: This page is not served over HTTPS. networkQuality needs HTTPS through the reverse proxy (or server.public_url), so the URL shown may not be the one to use.
networkquality.note: networkQuality needs TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2 at the reverse proxy. Over HTTP/1.1 or plain HTTP it won't run.

serverJson.caption: Or let the CLI fetch the list from this server
serverJson.copy: Copy librespeed-cli command with server list URL

methodology.title: How it measures
methodology.summary: Download and upload run over one or more HTTP streams; the warm-up is discarded before the rate is computed. Latency is measured idle over WebSocket (HTTP if unavailable), then again under load — the increase sets the bufferbloat grade. Quality ratings for streaming, gaming and video calls are derived from those numbers.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no ads. The server keeps no results — history lives only in your browser.
